beats.label: hook
beats.text: EA Sports rebuilt the contact physics from scratch — fighters ragdoll and react to damage in real time, and a Flow State mechanic unlocks when you control the pace.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: Max Holloway and Alex Pereira on the cover. Markerless Capture tech makes every fighter's movement and strikes feel unique to them. Striking, grappling, and ground game all updated with real-time contact reactions. Flow State rewards sustained offensive pressure — nail the pace and your fighter's signature abilities unlock enhanced versions that can end a fight.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Hall of Legends mode lets you relive iconic UFC moments across fighting history. The Legacy mode builds a career from small venues to title shots. This is the most feature-complete UFC game EA has shipped — and the contact physics rewrite is the most visible proof.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: EA Sports UFC 6 releases June 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Ultimate Edition gets 7-day early access.
